rounds.proof_sketch: Mutation at line 110 is in BFloat16 branch. Input spec fixes dtype=float32, which takes the first branch (line 79-88) with unmutated grid_size calculation. BFloat16 path (lines 102-117) containing the mutation is never executed.
rounds.survival_reason: The mutation modifies grid_size calculation specifically in the BFloat16 processing path. However, the fixed input specification mandates dtype=torch.float32, which causes the kernel to take the float32-specific branch that has its own separate (unmutated) grid_size calculation. The mutated code at line 110 is dead code under this configuration. If BFloat16 inputs were used, the -1 would cause 1024 tail elements (4 elements × 256 threads in the missing block) to remain uninitialized, producing large differences.
rounds.kill_strategy: Cannot kill under current contract. Would require changing input dtype to torch.bfloat16, which violates the fixed-dtype contract. With bfloat16, the mutation would leave the last 1024 elements unprocessed.
rounds.recommendations: Mutation testing tools should verify that mutations target code paths actually reachable under the fixed input configuration. This mutation survived because it affects only the BFloat16 path while the contract fixes dtype=float32. Consider flagging mutations in dtype-specific branches when the test contract fixes the dtype.
